title: Books of the Bible Crossword Puzzles — OT & NT
heading: The Books of the Bible Crosswords
meta: Two 15×15 grids · Hard · Old & New Testament
description: Two Books of the Bible crosswords — Old Testament and New Testament. Learn the 66 books through clues, from Genesis to Revelation. Free on iPhone and iPad.
prose: Can you place all 66? Books of the Old Testament and Books of the New Testament are a matched pair of harder puzzles where every answer is a book of the Bible — and every clue tells you what makes that book itself. The book of one hundred fifty songs. The shortest of the four gospels. The letter describing the armour of God.

They're two of the most satisfying grids in the archive, and a genuinely good way to learn your way around Scripture — solve them once and you'll never lose Habakkuk again. Both sit in the Hard section, with fair hints if a minor prophet escapes you.

clues.text: Book of one hundred fifty songs and prayers
Prophet who spoke of locusts and the Spirit poured out
Paul's pastoral letter to a young minister
